text: {"frames":["The fog smelled of warm cheese, and a small voice inside it was counting steps, always one step behind you. You follow the voice up the wet stones to the mill, where a pizza sits on the windowsill, cut into equal slices, {a} slices in all. The voice stops at the sill and whispers that it has been counting for a long time without any supper. You break the pizza into two heaps on the tray so the voice can see them. How many slices make half of the pizza?","\"Please, help us,\" says a note tied to an empty boat that drifts in under the bridge at Misty Ford. The boat holds a locked casket and a pizza in market paper, cut into equal slices, {a} slices in all. The note says the casket opens for whoever shares half the pizza with the old cat who sleeps in the bow. The cat is already awake and watching the crust. You look at the knife, then at the cat, then back at the casket. How many slices make half of the pizza?","\"Who put a floor here?\" you say, because the stairs have gone up one step too far. The new floor has a small tray on a stool, and on the tray lies a pizza cut into equal slices, {a} slices in all. Someone has left a trail of cheese from the tray to the little door in the wall. The door is shut, and a faint scratching comes from behind it. The door opens only for half of the pizza, so you must set aside exactly that much. How many slices make half of the pizza?","A smell of tomato and hot dough drifts up the stairs of the Tower. In the garden below, every tulip has been moved overnight into a round pattern, like petals around a centre. In the middle of the pattern lies a pizza cut into equal slices, {a} slices in all, and nobody in Misty Ford will say who brought it. The baker's bell rings from the town, and the tulips seem to lean towards the pizza. You need to share it out so the pattern stays whole. How many slices make half of the pizza?","You push open the mill door, and the sails begin to turn although there is no wind at all. Up in the loft a pizza sits on a clean cloth, cut into equal slices, {a} slices in all. The loft hatch rattles, and a draught blows the flour off the floor in a little swirl. The mill wants its share before it will stop turning, and the miller's bell is ringing somewhere above you. How many slices make half of the pizza?"]}
